Ao Tanaka.note: Tanaka stands out for moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Ao Tanaka.noteZh: 他的突出特点是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Ayase Ueda.note: Ueda is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Ayase Ueda.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Ayumu Seko.note: Seko's signature is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Ayumu Seko.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定上。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Daichi Kamada.note: Watch Kamada for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Daichi Kamada.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在防线重组前制造干净射门。留意他如何第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Daizen Maeda.note: Maeda's edge is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Daizen Maeda.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Hiroki Ito.summary: Hiroki Ito is a Japan left-footed centre-back at Bayern Munich who gives the national team passing balance, recovery cover, and aerial defending.
Hiroki Ito.note: Ito's edge is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Hiroki Ito.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Junnosuke Suzuki.note: Watch Suzuki for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Junnosuke Suzuki.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Junya Ito.note: Itō is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Junya Ito.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Kaishu Sano.note: Sano's signature is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Kaishu Sano.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在防线重组前制造干净射门上。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Keisuke Goto.note: Gotō's edge is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Keisuke Goto.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是等防守者注意力转移后再启动。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Keisuke Osako.note: Ōsako's signature is staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Keisuke Osako.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注上。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Keito Nakamura.note: Nakamura is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Keito Nakamura.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Kento Shiogai.note: Shiogai is defined by starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Kento Shiogai.noteZh: 他靠在防守者仍盯着球时提前启动与同位置球员拉开差异。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Koki Ogawa.summary: Koki Ogawa is a Japan centre-forward at NEC Nijmegen who gives the national team penalty-box finishing, aerial presence, and striker depth.
Koki Ogawa.note: Ogawa is defined by seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Koki Ogawa.noteZh: 他靠比防线早一步看到决定性的传球与同位置球员拉开差异。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Kou Itakura.note: Watch Itakura for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Kou Itakura.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。留意他如何用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Ritsu Doan.note: Watch Dōan for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He shifts onto his left foot and shoots with little backlift. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Ritsu Doan.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。留意他如何把球调整到左脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Shogo Taniguchi.note: Taniguchi's edge is calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Shogo Taniguchi.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Shuto Machino.note: Machino's signature is giving centre-backs a physical problem they cannot ignore. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Shuto Machino.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在让中后卫无法忽视的身体支点作用上。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Takefusa Kubo.note: Kubo stands out for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Takefusa Kubo.noteZh: 他的突出特点是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Takehiro Tomiyasu.note: Tomiyasu is defined by the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Takehiro Tomiyasu.noteZh: 他靠在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构与同位置球员拉开差异。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Tomoki Hayakawa.note: Hayakawa is defined by staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Tomoki Hayakawa.noteZh: 他靠在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注与同位置球员拉开差异。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Tsuyoshi Watanabe.note: Watanabe is defined by choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Tsuyoshi Watanabe.noteZh: 他靠选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Yuito Suzuki.note: Suzuki's signature is creating a better angle for the next pass. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward.
Yuito Suzuki.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在为下一脚传球制造更好的角度上。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。

Yukinari Sugawara.note: Sugawara stands out for delivering the ball without needing much space. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Yukinari Sugawara.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在很小空间里也能送出传中的能力。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Yuto Nagatomo.note: Watch Nagatomo for calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Yuto Nagatomo.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断。留意他如何用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Zion Suzuki.note: Suzuki's edge is staying balanced until the shot reveals its direction. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Zion Suzuki.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在射门方向明确前保持身体平衡。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。
